scope: selected historical TRAIN zero/low-score cohorts, mostly ADAPT repeated exposure; not population rates and not fixed-theta probe

definitions.ND_fraction: mean(non_drivable_body_by_time[1:]); 40 postinitial0.1s sampled flags, not fraction of body area
definitions.censored_no_event: None right-censored at4s; internal4.1 sentinel for finite horizon ordering, never proof beyond horizon
definitions.comparisons: Only cost-tied groups and equal (NC,DAC,TTC) pairs; all risk coordinates nonworse + comfort/direction nonworse; strict time gap0.2s or ND occupancy gap0.05; strict DAC arm additionally requires occupancy decrease and rawprogress no lower by>1m
definitions.raw_progress_only: same all risk coordinates, progress gap>=1m; counted for audit, not selected for proposed arm
